collector.name: Collector
dialog: Ships bring all sorts into this harbour from over the sea.
I'm on the quay first thing every morning to see what's come in. You never know!

lass.name: Lass
dialog: My Psyduck could watch the boats on the canal all day.
It just sits there, holding its head, and never says a word. Well, apart from "Psy?"

pokemon_breeder_m.name: Man
dialog: Out at sea there's an island riddled with old mine tunnels: Iron Island.
Nobody digs there now, but trainers go over to train in the dark. A sailor down at the harbour takes them across.

ace_trainer_f.name: Trainer
dialog: The Gym Leader here is Byron. His son Roark runs the Gym in Oreburgh City.
Steel-type Pokémon shrug off most moves. Fire, Fighting and Ground moves are the ones that get through.

old_man.name: Old Man
dialog: When a tall ship comes in, the bridge over the canal lifts right up to let it through.
I've watched it go up and down every day of my life, and I still stop to look.
